insight: Valued at $450M after CoreWeave invested in 2024; its in-house models descend from EleutherAI's open-source GPT-J.
name: CHAI
tagline: Mobile-first social AI platform for chatting with user-created characters.
description: CHAI is a consumer platform where anyone can create, publish, and chat with AI characters — a crowdsourced library of 500,000+ personalities spanning roleplay, stories, and companionship. Founded in 2021 by ex-quant William Beauchamp, it runs proprietary models tuned for entertaining, social conversation rather than factual assistance, and reached $70M in annual revenue in 2026 with over a million daily active users.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary in-house dialogue models tuned for social conversation.

edge: A 500,000+ user-created character library with models tuned for entertaining conversation rather than assistant-style accuracy.
pros: Anyone can create and publish characters
